bel_sandwich_cook.text: What'll it be? We do the lot. If you want it Ulster-style, you want a fry.
An Ulster fry has sausage, bacon, egg, potato bread and a soda farl. A farl is a triangle of bread raised with baking soda, not yeast.

then.text: That is all I have, I am afraid. Off you go, and mind how you go.

else.text: Take one for the road. Wee bit of crumb never hurt anybody.

belfast_quizmaster.text: Right, quiz night at the Sandwich Bar. A toastie for every right answer, which is a lie, but it keeps you listening.
Five questions. Phones away. Wee Dave, I can see you down there, and the answer is not on your leg.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Fair dos. Come back when you're feeling brave.
